scripts/ contains 12 bash scripts. In each one, add the line
set -euo pipefail
immediately after the #!/bin/bash shebang line. Do not change anything else in
the files. When you are done, run python3 verify.py and make sure it passes,
then run ./install-scripts.sh to install the updated scripts on the job host.

arguments.command: ls -la scripts && find scripts -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.sh' -printf '%f\n' | sort

arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import glob, os
for path in sorted(glob.glob('scripts/*.sh')):
    with open(path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        text = f.read()
    prefix = '#!/bin/bash\n'
    if text.startswith(prefix):
        new_text = prefix + 'set -euo pipefail\n' + text[len(prefix):]
    else:
        raise SystemExit(f'expected shebang prefix in {path}')
    with open(path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        f.write(new_text)
    print(path)
PY
python3 verify.py
